_doc: EXPERIMENT VARIANT (exp3 arm B): 256 anime caption route shifted to TAG-DOMINANT (tag_medium 10->70). Copy of t5_sampling_complete_v1.json; ONLY anime.caption.stage_route_weights_has_nl['256'] changed. Do not use for production training. Original _doc: MoT complete_v1 sampling config = daily_v1 (real+synth 21M, UNCHANGED) + anime (team pool 16.5M static, exposure ~10-12M-equiv). Extends configs/t5_sampling_daily_v1.json by adding the anime domain +

manifest.anime_caption_source: /s3/evan/anime_core_ditv04_ct_soft/data (read caption fields back by `key` at train time)

pool._note: daily_v1 real+synth = 21M (unchanged). anime manifest holds ALL 16.5M (NSFW kept; no static filter). Per-epoch anime exposure is shaped to ~10-12M-equiv by domain_mix + ct_weight bounded resample, NOT by trimming. complete exploration scale ~30M-equiv.

domain_mix._note: 4-way (aggressive anime, Evan). Each stage sums to 1.0. Within-real split at 256 = MONET-real:GPIC = 11:7 (= the daily static pool 11M:7M NATURAL ratio; Evan 2026-06-17, REPLACES the earlier 80:20 so GPIC keeps its natural share for real photographic diversity). 512 NOW INCLUDES GPIC (Evan 2026-06-17: 512 was sample-light @51.2M vs i1 256M; add GPIC for real-photo data volume; anime/synth held, real budget 0.31 split monet:gpic = 0.23:0.08 ~= 74:26). 1024 GPIC stays out -- elig_1024==0 (GPIC has ZERO images >=1024px, physically unavailable). anime全程主力。Loader must renorm defensively against missing/empty domains per stage.

_stage_pool_static._src: QC complete_v1_qc.json stage_pools (authoritative). NOTE: anime routes by RESOLUTION (elig_*), not by caption -- all rows kept.
_stage_pool_static.1024: 16.04M (anime>=1024 10.99M + MONET>=1024 2.05M + synth 3M); of the 10.99M anime>=1024, 8.17M carry NL

resolution_routing._note: Eligibility masks. Use each manifest's elig_256/elig_512/elig_1024 columns directly. anime: 256 all (16.499M) / 512 elig_512==1 (>=512, 16.29M) / 1024 elig_1024==1 (>=1024, 10.99M). 1024 routes ALL >=1024 rows by resolution, NOT by caption (8.17M of them carry NL). GPIC@512 ENABLED (Evan 2026-06-17): elig_512==1 (~16.5% of GPIC = ~1.15M >=512px). GPIC@1024 stays out: elig_1024==0 (GPIC has 0 images >=1024px, physically unavailable).

anime._note: Anime domain (target domain). Manifest = thin pointer index (t5_manifest/daily_v1/anime). Caption text + raw booru tags are NOT in the manifest; read from the source parquet by `key` at train time. Recommended: reuse naifu caption builder directly (it consumes these source fields). Sampling aligns to naifu sampling_plan.md.
anime._implementation_note: This spec EXTENDS naifu; it is NOT auto-consumed by stock naifu code -- the training-side loader must read THIS config and implement: (1) a REFETCH/JOIN layer keyed by `key` to the source parquet /s3/evan/anime_core_ditv04_ct_soft/data -- the thin manifest deliberately omits caption text / raw tags, but naifu PretrainImagesBuilder needs tags_*/refined_description/medium/short/quality_z/caption_policy etc.; (2) ct_weight as the priority BASE (naifu's active sampler uses ct_weight_power=0 i.e. IGNORES ct_weight -- here ct_weight drives, per exec doc §8 #6); (3) per-stage (256/512/1024) caption route weights (naifu caption_builder uses a single fixed policy table with no curriculum-stage concept -- per-stage schedule is per v3 canon). Pointing stock naifu at this config without these changes will silently fall back to naifu defaults.
anime.image_fetch: R2 HTTP via s3key (https://ncotar-worker.mewtant.workers.dev/r2/<key>); loader uses naifu training/r2_utils.py. NOT on local mount.

caption._note: Per v3 设计正本 (model+train doc §Caption) + exec doc §7, aligned to naifu caption_builder. Field mapping: NL-long=refined_description; NL-short=short_description (medium_description fallback); tag=tags_{artist,character,copyright,general,meta} category-ordered; rating ONLY questionable/explicit render as 'rating:<x>' (general/sensitive not emitted, naifu caption_plan.md:128).

stage_route_weights_has_nl._note: Per-stage NL<->tag schedule (Evan: 平滑过渡, 2026-06-17). 256 = v3 canon (NL-heavy, prompt-following); shift toward tag at 512; tag-dominant at 1024. Format keys are naifu routes; semantic labels in parens.

256._note: EXP3 ARM B (tag-dominant @256). A/B vs complete_v1 baseline (rich_nl:50/nl:20/nl_short:20/tag_medium:10). Only this block differs.

route_weights_no_nl._note: rows without visual NL (has_nl==0, ~29% global): pure tag route, all stages. tag-only rows are NEVER dropped.

other_naifu_policy_tables._note: Carried verbatim from naifu caption_plan.md for rows whose caption_policy/strategy selects them (concept/artist/character/nl_heavy). Unknown policy -> quality_default (the stage table above).

tag_frequency_dropout._note: naifu common-trait dropout (frequency_weighted_tag_dropout). Emphasized at Stage2 (1024) per v3 canon: drop high-frequency general tags to prevent popular-tag overfit + protect long-tail characters/styles. Shard-local tag frequencies (naifu set_general_tag_frequency).

length_cap._note: naifu _apply_length_cap on general-body tags (anchors/aux protected): 30% keep<=max(10,ceil(0.3N)); 10% keep<=min(6,N); 15% keep rand[1,5]; 45% no cap.

anchor_keep_probs._note: naifu meta-anchor throttling (caption_plan.md). rating only q/e emitted.

caption._text_max_length_note: GLOBAL model constraint (all domains): text_max_length=296 ≈ template ~39 tok + caption ~256 tok. Excess is HARD-TRUNCATED by the tokenizer (the row is NOT dropped). Loader MUST pre-truncate the caption at a sentence/tag boundary to 224-256 tok (not mid-token); the e2e dry-run MUST report the realized truncation rate so a large fraction of captions isn't silently hard-cut. Applies to real/synth captions too.
caption._caption_dropout_note: 10% caption dropout全程 (CFG support), consistent with real/synth. naifu gates uncond drop to quality-pool rows (is_quality_cfg_dropout_eligible); concept/artist/character anchor rows never blanked.
caption.builder: reuse naifu training/caption_builder.py (consumes source parquet fields directly); or equivalent in MoT loader aligned to the above.

sampling._note: naifu sampling_plan.md priority model: cluster-balanced construction primary, then bounded per-row priority -> integer repeat (exposure shaping, NOT static selection). NO real-style static Gumbel select (team soft-calibration is designed for full weighted use).

priority._note: priority = clip( ct_weight + quality_bonus + Σ lane_bonus + rare_concept_bonus + composition_clean_bonus, 1.0, max_priority). ct_weight (1.0-2.5, manifest col) is the bounded base per exec doc §8 (#6); naifu additive bonuses stack on top; clipped at cap; then -> integer repeat up to max_repeat. ct_weight/ct_lanes are cell-relative (do NOT compare across sources/levels).

quality_bonus._note: quality_z/hps read from source parquet at train time

lane_bonus._note: Per ct_lanes member (manifest col). naifu defaults; keys map to the delivered ct_lanes vocab (e.g. artist_canonical, quality_completion, concept_*, base_supplement). Lanes not present just contribute 0.

composition_clean_bonus._note: naifu row-level clean predicate (simple-bg + no watermark/sig tag + near-zero YOLO added-text + quality_z>=0.4)

lane_caps._note: Evan 2026-06-17: SOFT down-weight (×0.3), keep in pool (not excluded). Guards against no-prompt text rendering / comic-panel / photoreal drift. plain_illustration (13.57M bulk) untouched. v3 设计正本 §四 text-side-effect monitoring backs this intent.

sampling.static_select: NONE (manifest holds all 16.5M; exposure via domain_mix + this priority model)

exploration_scale._note: Do NOT statically trim anime. Static available = 16.5M (all kept). Per-epoch anime EXPOSURE target ~10-12M-equiv is a goal, NOT a static cut -- the realized number depends on the per-stage step/epoch budget, which is TBD (training-side; v3 '绝对步数待定'). The 30M-nominal epoch in QC oversample_factor is illustrative only (used to flag any domain forced to oversample). A smaller static subset can be cut separately if ever needed; default = no trim.

_source_alpha_note: real(MONET) within-domain source flatten, LIGHTENED (static daily pool already flattened at alpha=0.7 selection). Set 0 to use static pool as-is. anime uses cluster_balance instead.
_cluster_beta_note: real within-domain cluster flatten, LIGHTENED (static pool already cluster-flattened gamma=0.6+floor). anime cluster balancing uses its own cluster_balance axis (see anime.sampling).
_aes_note: off for real (aes already a soft selection weight in daily_v1). anime uses ct_weight/quality, aes is soft reference only.
_monet_real_gpic_ratio_note: Within-real (MONET-real:GPIC) split per stage. 256 = 11:7 = [0.611,0.389] (= daily static pool 11M:7M NATURAL ratio; Evan 2026-06-17, REPLACES earlier 80:20). 512 = [0.742,0.258] (Evan 2026-06-17: GPIC re-added @512, real budget 0.31 -> monet 0.23 / gpic 0.08; GPIC@512 pool ~1.15M elig_512). 1024 = [1,0] (GPIC has 0 images >=1024px). Equivalent domain_mix: 256 monet 0.397/gpic 0.253; 512 monet 0.23/gpic 0.08.

stage_band_supply_warning._note: daily_v1 1024 (real+synth) CANNOT assume T1/T2/T3/T4=18/27/15/40 without resampling (audit 2026-06-17). complete_v1: anime dominates 1024 (domain_mix anime=0.80; anime>=1024 10.99M, of which 8.17M carry NL/refined -> abundant T4), greatly relieving the real/synth 1024 caption supply. But the real/synth 1024 slice (domain_mix 0.08+0.12) still follows its own band-first supply — confirm via complete_v1 QC stage_caption_supply before training 1024.

1024_real_synth.required_action: For the real/synth portion of 1024, do not use band_mix_real unchanged unless allowing controlled resampling; otherwise choose a 1024-specific band mix. anime portion is caption-rich and unaffected.

band_to_captioner_priority._note: real/synth only (identical to母池 t5_sampling_weights_v1.json). MONET: first captioner whose tok_* is in the drawn band; soft preference. GPIC uses i1 caption; synth uses generation prompt. anime uses its own caption routing (see anime.caption).

daily_extra_columns._note: daily_v1 real/synth manifest columns beyond the 33-col rich schema (unchanged).
daily_extra_columns.wk: watermark prob (float; GPIC=NaN). Already hard-cut >source-p95 at selection.

loader_rules._note: real/synth: same 8 rules as configs/t5_sampling_weights_v1.json (holdout exclude, band eligibility by tok>0, GPIC@512/1024=0, aes-missing, global stats, domain_mix renorm, image-source=.tar). anime: image via R2 (s3key); caption via source-parquet re-fetch by `key`; stage routing by elig_*; exposure by anime.sampling priority + lane_caps; NSFW kept; tag-only rows never dropped.
loader_rules.domain_mix_renorm: renormalize present domains per stage to sum 1.0 (e.g. 512/1024 have no GPIC).
